title: AXI4 Random Access Memory
text: Model random access through external memory, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Initial value} sets Initial memory value; {Memory simulation} sets the simulation timing accuracy, {Memory selection} sets the between memory regions, {Region size (bytes)} sets the size of buffer, in bytes, {Initialize memory content} sets the initialize memory for simulation, {Log memory content}, {Log variable name} sets the variable name for memory, {Dimensions}, {Data type}, {Sample time} sets the time interval of sampling, {Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)} sets the pack data on the last dimension, {Output data signal matches input} sets the reader and writer use the same values and {View performance plots} displays performance metrics. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: wrData
ports.summary: Writer data bus signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: rdData
ports.summary: Output data signal to data consumer scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: rdCtrlOut
ports.summary: Reader control signal from memory channel to data consumer bus

ports.name: wrCtrlOut
ports.summary: Writer control signal from memory channel to data producer bus

params.name: Memory simulation

params.values: Choose between memory regions PS memory (default) | PL memory
